What every required check does when a merge queue asks

Issue #3189. A merge queue tests the merged result on a temporary gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-N ref and fires a merge_group event there. It merges only when every required context reports success on that ref. A context that never reports stalls the queue; a context that fails removes the entry.

Main's 18 required contexts, per event

Pick an event. "Before" is the tree on main when this page was written; "after" includes this change.

contextworkflowoutcomewhy

GitHub counts a job skipped by its if: as success for a required check, which is why PR-only gates can stay required on main without blocking the queue.

The ruleset this prepares (not applied)

settingvaluereason
merge methodSQUASHmain already requires linear history, and every PR lands squashed today
groupingALLGREENeach entry in a group must pass on its own, so one red PR never merges on the back of a green neighbour
group sizemin 1, max 5a solo maintainer should never wait for a partner PR; bot bursts (Dependabot groups, parallel sessions) still batch
build concurrency5each build is about 50 check runs; 5 bounds CI spend during a burst
wait for min group5 minmoot at min 1; it only matters if min is raised to trade latency for CI minutes
check timeout60 minTests & Security ran 4m39s on #4100, but the job timeouts in its longest chain add up past 60
queue-required checksCI Summary, Validation Summary, Validate Renderertwo fan-in aggregators plus the one check that reports on every PR and is not aggregated; all three run on both events
